steps.content:
Both listings you linked are **identical** on every key detail I could find — there is no objective reason to prefer one seller over the other based on the pages alone.

Here is what I saw when I checked both links:

| | **Seller A - Brackmoor Sound** | **Seller B - Ottervale Audio** |
|---|---|---|
| **Product** | Quellwyn Stillwave H2 Wireless Noise-Cancelling Over-Ear Headphones - Graphite | Same |
| **Price** | $129.00 | $129.00 |
| **Rating** | 4.3 out of 5 (210 reviews) | 4.3 out of 5 (210 reviews) |
| **Stock / Shipping** | In stock. Free standard shipping, arrives in 3 to 5 business days | Same |
| **Returns** | 30-day returns. Buyer pays return shipping. Refund to original payment method | Same |
| **Warranty** | 1-year limited warranty | Same |
| **Specs / In the box** | Same - 40h battery with ANC on, Bluetooth 5.3, USB-C, 254g, case + cables | Same |

Because price, shipping speed/cost, return policy, warranty, rating/review count, and specifications are all the same, neither listing offers a better deal, faster delivery, or better buyer protection on paper.

**So which to choose?**

Either one is functionally the same choice based on the information shown. If you have to pick one you can choose either — you could base it on:
1. Any prior experience you've had with either seller name
2. A quick outside search for independent reviews of the seller, since the product pages themselves don't show a difference
3. Personal preference - they are interchangeable here

Note: Both pages are on `listing-test-sooty.vercel.app`, which looks like a test/demo store, not a real retailer. If this is a real purchase, double-check you're on the actual retailer's official site before paying.
